files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
3MF, AMF, DAE and X3D files now get thumbnails while folders are browsed, like every other model. FreeCAD files show only the part FreeCAD itself shows, instead of every step of its history on top of each other.

### Added
- 3MF, AMF, DAE (COLLADA) and X3D files get a thumbnail while you browse Files, like every other model, instead of only once opened in the viewer. Their loaders read XML with the browser's `DOMParser`, which the background worker does not have; the worker now loads its own XML parser (`@xmldom/xmldom`) for these formats only, and the viewer keeps the browser's. The parser fetches nothing a file names, such as an external DTD or entity, and expands no entity a file declares, so a crafted file can neither make a request nor multiply itself. Parsing still takes memory in proportion to the file, about 31 bytes per character for a 3MF mesh, so XML longer than 16 Mi characters (roughly a 250,000-triangle 3MF, measured unzipped) is not parsed in the background: the file is skipped for its version, like one that runs out of time, and gets its thumbnail when opened in the viewer. As with OBJ, glTF and FBX, a DAE or X3D texture the file names is downloaded with it, and a file whose named texture cannot be found is left for the viewer rather than given an untextured thumbnail; a 3MF carries its textures inside it. Only `.nc` and `.g` files, which may not be G-code at all, are still left to the viewer.

### Fixed
- FreeCAD files (`.fcstd`) showed every step of a part's history on top of each other, in the viewer and in their thumbnail: a PartDesign part with a Pad and a Pocket drew the Pad's uncut solid around the finished part, and the tool the Pocket cut away sticking out of it. FreeCAD saves a shape for every feature and shows only some of them; the loader drew them all. It now draws only the objects `GuiDocument.xml` marks visible, and nothing inside a hidden Body or App::Part, which FreeCAD hides as a whole while their members stay marked visible (the tips of two Bodies combined by a Part Cut, for one). A file saved without it (by FreeCADCmd), or one where nothing visible can be drawn, is drawn whole as before. In FreeCAD's own PartDesign example this is 1 solid instead of 18; in its Part workbench engine block, 10 shapes instead of 35.

### Security
- Finding the texture and material files a COLLADA, X3D, OBJ or MTL upload names took time that grew with the square of the file's size, so a crafted upload of a few megabytes could keep the server busy for minutes. These files are now read in a single pass, on the server and in the browser.
